One of our clients in Oman is looking for MEP Engineer, to join its in-house Design Management team. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems as well as wet and dry infrastructure coordination for company's development portfolio.

This is a multidisciplinary coordination role spanning both building-level MEP systems and site-wide infrastructure, supporting projects at different stages — from master planning and design development through to construction-stage technical support.
q: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 15 years of post-graduate experience in MEP engineering, with substantial exposure to multidisciplinary infrastructure coordination.
Demonstrated experience on large-scale residential, mixed-use, or hospitality developments.
Experience working on consultant / developer / client-side teams, coordinating design consultants.
Familiarity with GCC building codes, municipal utility authority requirements, and relevant international standards (ASHRAE, IEC, NFPA).
Experience in master planning infrastructure coordination is highly desirable.
Strong proficiency in technical review of engineering drawings, specifications, and Design Basis Reports.
r: Support master planning activities including infrastructure requirements definition, utility capacity assessments, and coordination with master developers and regulatory authorities.
Coordinate wet utilities (potable water, irrigation, sewerage, stormwater drainage) and dry utilities (electrical distribution, telecoms, IT/ICT) across development plots.
Review and manage interfaces between infrastructure design consultants and building MEP consultants to ensure integrated, coordinated designs.
Participate in the development of shared infrastructure scope definitions, cost allocations, and technical submissions.
Review consultant MEP and infrastructure deliverables at each design stage for technical adequacy, code compliance, and alignment with project parameters.
Coordinate building services design across residential, hospitality, and amenities packages.
Provide MEP design clarifications and respond to technical queries from the Construction Manager and supervision consultants.
Support the review if MEP-related material submissions, shop drawings, and method statements where necessary for the client representative to be involved.
Support coordination between the design team and the Construction Manager on services-related matters during enabling works, substructure, and superstructure stages.
Assist in the review and resolution of design interfaces during construction, including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire life safety systems.
Provide continuous in-house technical MEP and infrastructure support, reducing reliance on external reviewers for routine technical matters.
Maintain technical records and ensure design documentation is current and properly coordinated.
Support the Design Manager in preparing technical reports, briefing notes, and management updates.
